description: Deep flow analysis: rates by transport and port, bandwidth, packet analysis, network type, top talkers, and raw flow detail.

panels.title: Total Flows
panels.description:
Total network flows in the selected time range.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Total Bytes
panels.description:
Sum of network.bytes across all flows.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Total Packets
panels.description:
Sum of network.packets across all flows. Packet counts reveal small-packet attacks invisible in byte totals.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Avg Flow Duration
panels.description:
Average event.duration across flows. Long-lived flows may be persistent connections or transfers.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: TCP Flows
panels.description:
Flow count filtered to TCP transport. TCP dominates most infrastructure traffic.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: UDP Flows
panels.description:
Flow count filtered to UDP transport. DNS, NTP, and some monitoring use UDP.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Unique Sources
panels.description:
Cardinality of source.ip. Sudden increases may indicate scanning or new hosts.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Unique Destinations
panels.description:
Cardinality of destination.ip. High values may indicate scanning or distributed access patterns.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Flow Rate by Transport
panels.description:
Flows per interval split by transport protocol.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Bandwidth Over Time
panels.description:
Source vs destination bytes over time. Shows traffic directionality.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Packets by Transport
panels.description:
Packet count per interval split by transport protocol. Complements flow rate with volume perspective.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Source vs Dest Packets
panels.description:
Source packets vs destination packets over time. Asymmetry indicates one-directional traffic patterns.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Flow Rate by Port
panels.description:
Flow count per interval split by destination port. Identifies busiest services.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Bandwidth by Port
panels.description:
Bytes per interval split by destination port. Shows which services consume the most bandwidth.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Flows by Source IP
panels.description:
Flow count split by source IP. Identifies chattiest clients.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Flows by Dest IP
panels.description:
Flow count split by destination IP. Identifies most-contacted servers.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Bytes by Source IP
panels.description:
Bytes split by source IP. Heavy senders may be backup jobs or data transfers.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Bytes by Dest IP
panels.description:
Bytes split by destination IP. Heavy receivers may be storage or ingest services.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: IPv4 vs IPv6
panels.description:
Flow count by network.type showing IPv4 vs IPv6 distribution. Our environment is predominantly IPv4.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Packets by Network Type
panels.description:
Packet volume split by IPv4/IPv6. Shows if IPv6 traffic carries proportionally more packets.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow

panels.title: Recent Flows
panels.description:
Raw flow documents with source, destination, port, protocol, byte/packet counts, community_id, and duration.
Source: Network Traffic integration → network_traffic.flow
